question: Does direct re-collation of the NCL-06267 C-II-N daily table repair the Batch 12CG day-67 approximation and reveal a historically transmitted 59/41 integer-ladder mechanism relevant to the Sanming/Yueling day-night-ke problem?
answer: YES FOR A FORWARD-ONLY C-II-N CELL CORRECTION AND A POST-1578 MECHANICAL HOMOLOGY; NO FOR IDENTIFYING THE PRE-1578 SANMING/YUELING PARENT. Direct no-OCR re-collation fixes half-day day66 at 2348.73 and day67 at 2355.37, giving full daylight 46.9746 and 47.1074 ke. Batch 12CG's day67=2348.62 was explicitly DIRECT_VISUAL_APPROX and is superseded for exact indexing only; its macro C-II-N/Nanjing range conclusion remains valid. The same physical page fixes day73 at 2395.26 (47.9052 ke) and day74 at 2401.90 (48.0380 ke), locating whole-ke crossings 47 and 48 between 66/67 and 73/74. Separately, postdated 1616 Zhu Yi and 1624 Leijing Tuyi preserve a coherent 59/41 stepped family; chronology blocks both as direct ancestors of Sanming 1578. The exact Sanming/Yueling Dahan 十三後 / Yushui 後四日 fingerprint still requires a pre-1578 carrier or explicit reduction/editorial rule.
